# Gap Coaching Reference — Example Candidate
Fictional sample used by the test suite.

---

## Python (Production Experience)

**Status:** 🟡 Course / portfolio — coursework and a portfolio project, no production use

**What to say:**
"Python skills come from structured courses and a portfolio project; the team's stack would be a ramp-up, not a start from zero."

**What not to say:**
- Claiming daily production use

**Best STAR bridge:** Story 4 (Example ramp-up)

**Honest floor:** Course-level proficiency with applied portfolio use.

---

## Oracle Databases

**Status:** 🔴 Genuine gap — SQL Server and MySQL present instead

**What to say:**
"Oracle is new to me; my database work is in SQL Server, and the relational fundamentals transfer."

**What not to say:**
- Pretending Oracle experience

**Best STAR bridge:** Story 2 (Example data migration)

**Honest floor:** No production Oracle experience.

---

## Cognos

**Status:** 🔴 Genuine gap — other reporting tools used

**What to say:**
"I have built reports with other tools and can learn a new reporting platform quickly."

**What not to say:**
- Claiming Cognos expertise

**Best STAR bridge:** Story 2 (Example data migration)

**Honest floor:** No Cognos experience.

---

## Power BI (as primary requirement)

**Status:** 🟡 Course only — dashboards built during training

**What to say:**
"I have built dashboards in training and want to deepen that in production."

**What not to say:**
- Calling myself a Power BI developer

**Best STAR bridge:** Story 4 (Example ramp-up)

**Honest floor:** Course-level only.

---

## CI/CD Pipelines (as primary must-have)

**Status:** 🟢 Production — owned a pipeline

**What to say:**
"I owned a pipeline and added automated test gates."

**What not to say:**
- Underselling pipeline ownership

**Best STAR bridge:** Story 1 (Example pipeline)

**Honest floor:** Production pipeline ownership.

---

## Unit Testing / TDD (if flagged as must-have)

**Status:** 🟢 Production — test coverage initiative

**What to say:**
"I raised test coverage on a claims module using xUnit and Moq."

**What not to say:**
- Claiming strict TDD on every project

**Best STAR bridge:** Story 1 (Example pipeline)

**Honest floor:** Unit and integration testing in production.

---

## Cloud / Azure (if flagged as must-have beyond fundamentals)

**Status:** 🟡 Fundamentals plus labs — limited production Azure

**What to say:**
"I hold the fundamentals certification and have hands-on lab work; deeper production Azure would be growth."

**What not to say:**
- Claiming Azure architect depth

**Best STAR bridge:** Story 3 (Example cloud migration)

**Honest floor:** Fundamentals certified with lab-level hands-on work.
